name: x-sp-def
effect: Used on a party Pokémon in battle : Raises the target’s Special Defense by one stage. Increases happiness by 1/1/0.
shortEffect: Raises Special Defense by one stage in battle. Raises happiness.

flavorTextEntries.text: An item that raises the Sp. Def stat of a Pokémon in battle. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.
An item that boosts the Sp. Def stat of a Pokémon during a battle. It wears off once the Pokémon is withdrawn.
An item that sharply boosts the Sp. Def stat of a Pokémon during a battle. It wears off once the Pokémon is withdrawn.
